function: Joint optimization of transceiver beamformers, consensus period and logical-to-physical topology mapping for over-the-air computation aggregation in decentralized federated learning over MIMO D2D links (pp. 2-3, 6-7)
system: N users with NT transmit and NR receive antennas (in-band full-duplex MIMO D2D), antenna counts not stated; no RIS; block fading, 915 MHz carrier (pp. 3, 8)
method: Decentralized federated learning (DSGD gossip averaging) of CNN and ResNet-18 with AirComp aggregation; beamformers by alternating optimization (QCQP), topology by BASE-GRAPH and QAP branch-and-bound (pp. 5-8)
data_channel: CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 images split across users, Dirichlet non-IID; own D2D channel: Friis path loss exponent 3.76 and i.i.d. Rayleigh fading, no standard channel (p. 8)
test_conditions: Users hold 80%-20% local train/test split; test accuracy under N=15 and 20, K, SNR 5 dB, Dirichlet alpha, 0% or 10% uncertainty; no unseen-scenario test (pp. 8-12)
baselines: Baseline 1 [15] joint beamforming and mixing matrix; Baseline 2 [34] zero-forcing; Baseline 3 [43] MMSE AirComp; fully connected; MATCHA [16]; MST (p. 9)
metrics: Test accuracy versus iterations, number of edges and total distance; objective value and computation time of topology matching (pp. 9-11)
complexity: Worst-case O(tau N^3 N!) for topology matching, O(N NT^3) for beamforming, O(1) for consensus period; measured B&B time 8.3 times the heuristic (pp. 8, 11)
q1_support: p. 8: "The D2D channels also experience i.i.d. Rayleigh fading." - custom Friis path loss plus Rayleigh fading in own simulator; no 3GPP, DeepMIMO, COST 2100 or measured channel.
q2_support: p. 11: "To validate the generalizability of our framework under data heterogeneity" - sweeps over Dirichlet alpha, N, K, SNR and uncertainty; no model trained in one setting is tested in another or adapted.
q3_support: p. 9: "The first baseline (Baseline 1) was developed in [15]", an earlier MIMO over-the-air DFL design; non-learned: "zero-forcing beamforming" (Baseline 2), MMSE (Baseline 3), FC, MST; p. 12: "improving over Baseline 1 by 6%" in test accuracy.
q4_support: p. 8: "the worst-case computational complexity of solving P1 is dominated by" O(tau N^3 N!); also O(N NT^3) for beamforming; p. 11: B&B takes "over 8.3 times increase in computation time".
q5_support: p. 8: "pixel RGB image from the CIFAR-10 dataset" - learning-task dataset only, channels are simulated; no code or data link and no public channel dataset.
notes: Included as area 7: AirComp-based decentralized FL; the learned element is the CNN or ResNet-18 trained across devices, while topology and beamformers are optimized by closed form, QCQP and branch and bound, not learned (pp. 3-8). MIMO links, antenna counts not stated. Title on p. 1 matches the DOI. Genetic algorithm only as heuristic for the matching subproblem (p. 9). Earlier conference version cited on p. 1.
